title: AI-103: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate
caseStudy:
Contoso, Ltd is a multinational retailer that builds generative-AI and agent solutions in Microsoft Foundry.

Identity: Microsoft Entra ID. Agent1Dev Team maintains AI solutions. Agent1Test Team validates before production. Access to Project1 uses security groups SC_Agent1_Dev and SC_Agent1_Test.

Projects: Project1 (EU region) hosts customer-support Agent1 on a base model. No safety evaluation pipeline, tool-approval workflow, or conversation memory is configured yet. Project2 has a video-generation model for Marketing; the app is unfinished.

Data: storage1 (Blob) holds PDF product sheets (specs, features, support text). Agent1 currently answers from general knowledge only and does not use those sheets. Finance still reviews vendor invoices by hand (tables, logos, mixed layouts).

Planned: invoice review that uses both layout and text; standardize Agent1’s model version; index product sheets so Agent1 can answer from them; finish video generation.

Technical: scalable high-throughput deployment with no reserved PTU, data stays in the EU, stable model version, semantic/vector index over product sheets, answers must be relevant and complete.

Security: no API keys to Foundry models; Entra auth; least privilege; Agent1 must never reveal customer data even if it lands in storage1; protect against malicious instructions hidden in images.

Business: personalized multi-session experience; Agent1 answers only about Contoso products.
